status: Implemented and technically verified; author art, ordinary tutorial and save checks remain pending.

native.engine: GZDoom 4.14.2, Windows 11, Vulkan, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti, 1520x825
native.development_dependencies: Local Doom II IWAD, id24res, engine support/widescreen resources. Engine, IWADs, native saves and isolated QA fixtures are not distributed.
native.music: After the author request, every final run explicitly logged snd_musicvolume=0 in the isolated issue98 configuration; sound effects and ordinary game settings unchanged.
native.log_export: UTF-8 LF; trailing line whitespace and trailing empty lines removed, all diagnostic content preserved.
native.fixture: Local issue98_qa, based on the issue62 native trial harness with additional camera, identity, physical melee, arrow and base-state probes. It calls native attack methods and waits for actual impacts; fixture-only accuracy/resource setup removes random misses.
scope: Caella primary/secondary actual spell impacts, misses, unrelated actor, nonmagic damage, cancelled cast, resource checks, retry, missing-target recovery, five practices, rune ordering and ordinary native completion gates.
Rulo projectile, primary/secondary/charged melee traces and bow arrow impact; missed melee and arrows do not advance the practice; same shared indestructible actor.
Original Radius 21, Height 72, Health 1000000, flags and position; tagged actor survives old/new loads without replacement or duplicates.
Front/back/left/right, close/far/diagonal under MAP01 lighting; stable fixed orientation, intact UVs and grounded base. Base Spawn and Death both visibly render the model.
Cold startup of the final PK3 without the QA fixture.
iteration_notes: Initial art captures exposed intersecting target discs; corrected before final captures and packaged tests.

Preliminary harness runs missed trailing assertions when quitting immediately after queued give commands; final probes wait before quitting and require explicit expected log markers. Multiline/alias startup attempts were discarded. A fixture-only bow enum typo was corrected before the recorded bow run.
Old-save creation and rollback logs use the retained 4.37.19 baseline package; they are not counted as final-package assertions.

saves.old_active: stage 40, primary complete, secondary/channel incomplete, runes 0, weapon ID 2, seal ID 3, target TID 9801.
saves.old_complete: stage 45, all five practices and four runes, passage open, loans returned, owned weapon ID 1, one target TID 9801.
saves.new_reload: Both saves were loaded in 4.37.20, written to separate new slots and verified after reload. The partial practice continued with an actual secondary impact.
saves.rollback: The new completed save also loaded with the retained 4.37.19 package, with completion and tagged target preserved. Original old saves remain untouched.
